summary: Ran `npx -y -p @angular/cli@16 ng update @angular/core@16 @angular/cli@16 --allow-dirty --force` from EFNgApp/EFNgApp/ClientApp on Node 18/npm 10, bumping the @angular/* packages to 16.2.12, the CLI/build-angular toolchain to 16.2.16, and zone.js to 0.13.3. The update's own migration disabled buildOptimizer for the non-optimized server build configuration in angular.json. The hop file listed no related packages to bump, but the build then failed with NG6002 because @ngrx/store, @ngrx/effects, @ngrx/router-store, @ngrx/store-devtools, and @ngrx/entity were still on the pre-Ivy v8.5.2 line (flagged as a risk in the prior hop's report); ran a second `ng update` for all five @ngrx/* packages to 16.3.0, which required no source changes and fixed the build. Separately, `npm run build:ssr` (not a required check, but exercised to catch regressions) broke because Angular 16 removed `renderModuleFactory` from @angular/platform-server entirely; the CLI's server builder now auto-injects `renderApplication`/`renderModule`/`ɵSERVER_CONTEXT` exports into main.server.ts itself, so the manual re-export in src/main.server.ts was removed (emptying the file) to avoid a duplicate-export conflict with the CLI-injected ones, restoring a clean build:ssr compile. Install and build both pass; test fails the same pre-existing way as baseline and every prior hop (angular.json's test target points at a nonexistent root-level styles.css instead of src/styles.css), and two pre-existing, unrelated TS typing errors in build:ssr (@types/jasmine, @types/ws) were verified present before this hop's changes too, so nothing new regressed.
changes: Upgraded @ngrx/store, @ngrx/effects, @ngrx/router-store, @ngrx/store-devtools, @ngrx/entity from ^8.5.2 to ^16.3.0 (required to fix NG6002 Ivy-incompatibility build errors against Angular 16's AOT compiler; not listed in the hop file but necessary)
Angular CLI migration: added `buildOptimizer: false` to the server builder's base options and `buildOptimizer: true` to its dev/production configurations in angular.json

Removed the manual `export { renderModuleFactory } from '@angular/platform-server'` from src/main.server.ts: Angular 16 removed renderModuleFactory, and the CLI's server builder now injects renderApplication/renderModule/ɵSERVER_CONTEXT exports into this file itself, so a manual re-export would duplicate-conflict with it
package-lock.json regenerated by npm as part of the update/install cycles
manual_followups: npm install still needs legacy-peer-deps (set project-wide via ClientApp/.npmrc in an earlier hop) because @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader@7.1.0 declares peers on @angular/core/@angular/platform-server ^7. It should move to an Angular-16-compatible replacement (the @nguniversal scope was merged into @angular/ssr from Angular 17 onward) in a later hop; the .npmrc override can likely be removed once it does.

`npm run test` fails before any spec executes because angular.json's test architect target still points at `styles.css` at the ClientApp root instead of `src/styles.css`; this predates this hop (present since baseline) and was left as-is per the rule that pre-existing failures don't need fixing.

`npm run build:ssr` (not a required check) reports two pre-existing TypeScript errors from @types/jasmine and @types/ws type-definition conflicts; verified present before this hop's dependency changes too, so left as-is.

src/app/app.server.module.ts still imports ModuleMapLoaderModule from @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader, and src/tsconfig.server.json still sets the deprecated `angularCompilerOptions.entryModule`; both are vestiges of the pre-Ivy Angular Universal template and should be reviewed/removed once the @nguniversal dependency is replaced.
